elements.name: The Paper
elements.subtitle: A timed set of cases — the thing a candidate actually opens, times and finishes. An exam's papers each end independently, and the exam is complete once every one of them has been ended.

elements.label: Exam
elements.placeholder: Which exam does this belong to?

elements.label: Slug
elements.placeholder: Left empty, generated from the title
elements.hint: Unique within its exam, not across the site — every exam is allowed a Paper 1

elements.label: Description
elements.placeholder: What this paper covers, shown before the candidate starts it

elements.name: The Clock
elements.subtitle: This is the timer that runs. In Timed mode the server ends the paper when it reaches zero; in Practice mode it runs on and nothing is closed.

elements.label: Duration (minutes)
elements.hint: Copied onto a sitting when the candidate opens the paper. Changing it later applies to new sittings only — anyone already part-way through keeps the time they were given

elements.label: Case Set Version
elements.hint: Bump this by hand after materially changing the case list, so a finished sitting records which revision it sat. It does not change what anybody is served — a sitting always replays from its own frozen copy

elements.label: Status
elements.hint: Inactive removes it from new sittings. Anyone mid-paper is unaffected and every finished one still replays

elements.label: Display Order
elements.hint: The order candidates meet the papers in
